correctness.rationale: Automorphism averaging of symmetric stochastic P preserves feasibility and cannot increase the convex norm ||P-J||, hence global minimizers can be sought in invariant core-edge a and pendant b. Nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues produce exact 2x2 block eigenvalues 1-t-b ± sqrt(t²+b²), t=a(d-lambda)/2. Noncompleteness guarantees lambda_2>=0 via nonedge Rayleigh 0 and negative lambda_min. The virtual zero-eigenvalue block is an actual block or convex combination of two actual nontrivial blocks. PSD of (4/5)I-B_0 forces determinant <= -(b-2/5)^2 and da+b=1, thus b=2/5, a=3/(5d). If lambda_2>0 that candidate violates .8; if lambda_2=0 all nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues <=0 and candidate attains .8. Negative-semidefinite-on-1-perp implies nonadjacent vertices have identical adjacency rows, hence balanced complete multipartite H. Independently checked 2x2 eigenblocks on C4,C6,C7,C8,Q3 and K2,2,2, and verified equality/non-equality. A statement of uniqueness only in the invariant class, not globally, is respected.
